name: SyncLicensingRequestDesk
tagline: From sync enquiry to signed licence – rate-card quotes, rights-holder approvals and licence issue in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete sync licensing desk for music publishers, labels and sync agencies: log requests, price them with a configurable rate card (media, territory, term, usage, duration, exclusivity), clear every co-publisher and the master owner, and issue numbered licences – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Configurable low-code rate card with step-by-step fee breakdown
Status workflow with allowed transitions and required data per status
Share-weighted publishing and master approvals with chase actions
Quote validity, expiry and discount control
Licence numbers and generated quote / licence text
Bulk status, owner and delete with undo; CSV export
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and ARIA support
